design.rationale: Spec is coherent on identity, single evaluator, admission boundary, persistence, ADB/RemoteControl limits and three-authority separation. Accuracy loss: it asserts bridge-config.sql makes its invariants executable while that DDL diverges in names, enums, columns and omits tables (R2-02); small factual/consistency nits (R2-17). Completeness loss: unknown-raw grant model has no storage/scope schema (R2-03); cross-release registry generation and idempotency/audit storage unspecified (R2-04, R2-08).

contracts_schema.rationale: One cat1 ETag formula is consistent across API-CONTRACT, runtime_catalog view, builder and oracle; registry enum, logic vocabulary and NOT NULL PKs verified. Defects: generation reset per build and duplicated stored etag (R2-04); contract MUSTs not enforced by constraints (R2-07); idempotency scoping unrepresentable (R2-08); schema_version const contradicts minor negotiation claim (R2-11); openapi boilerplate residue (R2-13).

extractor.rationale: parsers.py handles headers, owner reset, symbolic constants, parameter-scoped annotations, AIDL directions/ordinals and distinct locators; N-02 publication ordering fixed. Defects: hardcoded api_level/channel/android_version/registry_version for every source (R2-05); shipped foundation_extract.run() is broken against current schema and retains the F-08 bug (R2-06); stale export vocabulary (R2-10); assert-based verification (R2-12); scope cascade (R2-14); sdk-annotations path untested (R2-15); first-wins divergence hiding (R2-16); schema_hash conflated with document hash (R2-18).

production_catalog_data.rationale: Supplied evidence reports integrity ok, 0 JSON-schema and 0 FK failures, not independently audited. If built with the supplied builder, every one of 4,133 sources carries api_level 37 / channel stable, which is false for evidence, sdk-history and arbitrary-repo AIDL sources. Coverage: 4,133 of 17,822 retrieved and 20,957 selected sources; 10 of 1,160 core manifest permission definitions; SDK 37.2 archive unimported; AIDL parcelable/union/enum members, wire codes and codecs unknown.

overall.rationale: Design and contract work are near-complete but below 98 due to fixable artifact defects; overall completeness is dominated by materially incomplete production catalog source coverage, which is a missing input owned by the source task, not a relabelable gap.

changes.change: MISSING SOURCE INPUT: source task still has only release001/002; current retrieval and SDK37.2 import have not produced release003. No overall acceptance claimed.

Reconciled design names/columns/enums with bridge-config.sql, encrypted diagnostic fields, handles/config/targets, dispatched state, indexes and unique execution idempotency. Both SQL schemas coexist in a fixture DB.

Added client_raw_grants SQL, closed RawGrant schema and bounded positive ask/allow oracle including connection, descriptor, handle, display, code and flag restrictions. Known schemas always resolve binding policy first.

Added immutable registry_entries keyed by registry+entry and active projection views without stored etag. Input registry version seeds generation; registry IDs include metadata and cursor IDs include registry identity. Standalone serving replacement must advance version.

Required explicit catalog metadata and per-source applicability/channel; unknown API levels are nullable. Source identity scheme2 includes immutable provenance fields, with legacy IDs retained by copy migration.
Removed old importer run/CLI; foundation_extract.py now contains only expression helpers used by current parser.
Added imported overlay ID equality, canonical signature checks, revision-increase trigger and registry transition trigger. Updated fixture to legal exact ID and revision2.

Added principal/operation/key idempotency_records and immutable registry_events/outbox. Legacy import_jobs migrate to clearly separate legacy_import_jobs and cannot replay authenticated API operations.
Actual request-shape resolvers now generate and compare canonical plans for generated/generic/known raw paths, including stale/undecodable rejection.
Exporter samples permission/access vocabulary and requires a distinct fresh destination; input release is read-only.
Entry/Mutation envelopes accept documented1.x minor versions; unknown required semantics and major versions remain rejected for invocation. Reserved extension namespaces preserve additive fields.
Converted validation/fetch runtime assertions to explicit ValueError guards. No network acquisition performed by remediation.
Pruned search404 and publish404 ETag boilerplate; current tag exists only for known entry representations.
Explicit scope stack tracks unknown type headers so closing braces do not incorrectly pop the package.
External ZIP fixture covers declaration, parameter, unmatched and malformed XML; malformed member becomes partial issue with raw bytes retained; ordinal locator documented.
Discovery entries expose declaration_variants for return/kind/parameter/modifier differences, retaining occurrence evidence and unresolved reason.
Removed tools binding_id and documented legacy storagev2. Brightness subclaim rejected on current primary evidence: official Settings.System documents1..255, so retained original range.

Separated structural schema_hash, permission_hash and complete document_hash. Permission changes still invalidate grants in the publication/policy transaction; provenance-only changes leave schema hash stable.

new_source_identity_scheme: v2 hashes immutable acquisition metadata; legacy IDs preserved
